args: export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS= SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=never MISE_AUTO_INSTALL=0; unset SSH_ASKPASS; p=; m=$(command -v mise 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$m" ]; then p=$(cd / && "$m" which cartographer 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || p=; [ -x "$p" ] || p=; fi; if [ -z "$p" ]; then c=$(command -v cartographer 2>/dev/null); r=$(realpath "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo "$c"); case "$c|$r" in *"/mise/shims/"*|*"/mise/installs/"*) c= ;; esac; [ -n "$c" ] && [ -n "${MISE_DATA_DIR:-}" ] && case "$c|$r" in "$MISE_DATA_DIR"/*|*"|$MISE_DATA_DIR"/*) c= ;; esac; [ -n "$c" ] && [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$c" -ef "$m" ] && c=; p=$c; fi; if [ -n "$p" ]; then exec "$p" mcp; fi; echo "cartographer not found: install it with  mise use -g github:shermanhuman/cartographer  (or put a non-mise build on PATH)" >&2; exit 127
